_about: The I-751 cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The subject (joint petition or waiver), the address (USCIS 'Direct Filing Address for Form I-751', updated 09/24/2024: Elgin or Phoenix by state; schemas/uscis_lockboxes_i751.json) and the fee ($750 on paper, Form G-1055 10/01/26) come from src/conditions.py. The attorney approves this file before volume use.

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.
Enclose the filing fee by the enclosed Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or a Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check: the amount in the cover letter. Not when the letter says no fee is due.
